context: a single passage from a letter by J. D. Hooker, which you are answering on its own
exchanges: That paper in Flora to which you allude seems to be very good, I am thinking of getting it translated: would it not be much better for the Ray Club to confine its efforts to translating such things & leave it to Societies to publish original monographs, which with proper support the Socs. could do better than the Ray Club.

With respect to Ray Soc. I profited so enormously by its publishing my Cirripedia, that I cannot quite agree with you on confining it to translations; I know not how else I could possibly have published.—
